title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function combines two parts: the $L_2$ loss and the exponential regularization. The $L_2$ loss is represented by $1/n*||Y-X*theta||_2**2$. Can you identify how the regularization term $lambda*sum{i\=1}{p}{10**theta_i}$ affects the optimization process?

title: Matrix Inversion Insight
text: Consider the expression $(X**{-1}+lambda*I)*X**{T}*Y$. What role does the identity matrix $I$ play when added to $X**{-1}$? Think about how this affects the matrix inversion process.

title: Evaluating the Expression
text: Which of the following statements is true about the expression $(X**{-1}+lambda*I)*X**{T}*Y$?
choices: It does not account for regularization correctly
It is a valid solution for any lambda
It is the same as the normal equation solution
